content:
Successful HWPX manipulation achieved through regex-based placeholder replacement and XML layout cache removal.
The process utilized raw string regex to handle placeholders split across XML tags and implemented specific formatting for '참석자수', '만족도', and '종합의견'. Critical rendering issues were avoided by using xml.etree.ElementTree to remove <hp:lineSegArray> elements from modified paragraphs. The final HWPX package integrity was maintained by rebuilding the ZIP structure including the Contents/ and BinData/ directories.
